take-on-me-paper: Converts the source into a pencil-and-paper illustration with luminance-based hatching, adjustable hatch density, outline strength, and shadow darkness.
4-color-gradient: Composes a four-point color gradient with independently positioned color stops, jitter, blend amount, opacity, and selectable blend mode.
8bit-pixcam: Pixelates the image and quantizes it through a four-color palette with Bayer dithering, brightness/contrast controls, and optional grid lines.
a-bayangan: Builds a soft colored shadow from the source alpha, with distance, angle, softness, unmultiplied compositing, inversion, and HSL colorization controls.
a-glossy: Creates a glossy alpha-derived highlight using blurred contours, configurable multi-color fills, angle, gap, distance, choking, roundness, and blend mode.
a-halfdots: Renders the image as configurable half-tone dots or shapes with grid spacing, rotation, randomization, source or ramp coloring, and compositing controls.
a-innergradation: Applies layered inner gradients to selected source colors, supporting up to ten color selections with tolerance, local transforms, softness, distance, and angle controls.
a-outline: Generates one or two alpha-based outlines with independent colors, offsets, sizes, opacity, sharpness, and long-shadow settings.
a-wiggle: Animates position, scale, and rotation with procedural noise, offering separate axis amplitudes and frequencies, anchor control, and a random seed.
after-effects-mirror: Reflects the layer across a user-positioned, user-rotated mirror axis while preserving transparent regions outside the mirrored source.
analogtv: Simulates an analog CRT signal with scanlines, dot mask, gamma, halation, bloom, chromatic offsets, bleed, noise, jitter, hum bars, geometry, and vignette.
apple-ii-pixelated-dhgr: Maps the image to an Apple II DHGR-like 16-color palette with coarse pixel blocks and ordered dithering.
apple-ii-pixelated-hgr: Creates Apple II HGR-style pixelation by sampling the source on an adjustable pixel grid.
ascii: Replaces image cells with procedural ASCII glyphs, with selectable character set, column detail, font geometry, contrast, brightness, inversion, and image-colored text.
az-bend-it: Bends the layer between configurable start and end points, with pre-start rendering and additional distortion controls for the bend field.
az-bender: Applies selectable geometric bend styles, including Bend, Marilyn, Sharp, and Boxer, with distance-aware shaping between top and base points.
az-blobbylize: Fuses nearby source regions into soft blobby forms using a selected color or alpha channel, with adjustable fusion strength, softness, and cutaway.
az-block-load: Reveals the image through a progressive grid of blocks, controlling completion, scan count, cleared start state, and bilinear block interpolation.
az-bubbles: Overlays animated, wobbling bubbles with configurable amount, speed, size, reflections, and liquid or metallic shading modes.
az-burn-film: Creates a film-burn transition using animated fractal and Voronoi noise around a movable center, with burn amount and randomized motion.
az-cross-blur: Blurs the source along independent horizontal and vertical cross axes with radius, repeated-edge behavior, and selectable transfer mode.
az-cylinder: Wraps the layer around a rotatable 3D cylinder with radius, XYZ position, Euler rotation order, and front/back render mode controls.
az-drizzle: Simulates animated raindrop ripples and spreading rings over the layer, controlled by drip rate, longevity, displacement, ripple height, and spreading.
az-glass: Builds a glass-like relief from a height field, refracting the source with displacement and lighting while controlling property selection, height, softness, and edge gating.
az-grid-wipe: Performs a tiled grid transition with adjustable completion, center, rotation, tile count, tile shape, borders, and reversed direction.
az-griddler: Rearranges the image into scaled and rotated tiles with independent horizontal/vertical scale, pixel tile size, and optional tile cutting.
az-hextile: Reprojects the layer into a hexagonal tile layout with tile radius, center locking, rotation, and selectable tile folding or seam-smearing modes.
az-jaws: Reveals or conceals the layer through a directional jaws-shaped wipe with animated completion, center, width, height, and shape controls.
az-kaleida: Creates a kaleidoscopic reflection from a movable region with selectable mirroring patterns, rotation, size, and floating-center behavior.
az-lens: Applies a lens-style radial warp around a pixel-positioned center, with size and convergence controls and transparent-border handling.
az-light-burst-2-5: Adds a source-aware radial light burst with rays, halo, burst length, intensity, optional colorization, and a movable center.
az-light-rays: Draws directional or radial light rays from a center using selectable geometric shapes, source-color sampling, radius, softness, transfer mode, and intensity.
az-light-sweep: Sweeps a colored light band across the layer with selectable profile shape, direction, width, edge intensity/thickness, and source reception.
az-light-wipe: Reveals the source with a directional light-shaped wipe, controlling completion, center, shape, intensity, color sourcing, and reverse transition.
az-line-sweep: Reveals the layer with a slanted moving line whose completion, direction, thickness, slant, and flip direction are adjustable.
az-plastic: Creates a plastic-like surface response from source edges and an environment map, with height, softness, expansion cutoffs, and displacement controls.
az-radial-blur: Applies a center-based radial or spin blur with selectable type, amount, quality, center, and randomized sampling.
az-radial-fast-blur: Provides a lightweight radial zoom blur from a pixel-positioned center with amount, zoom, and standard/brightest/darkest accumulation modes.
az-radial-scalewipe: Transitions the layer through a radial scale expansion from a chosen center, with completion and reverse-direction controls.
az-rainfall: Generates animated falling raindrops over the source with controllable count, size, depth, speed, wind, spread, color, and opacity.
az-scale-wipe: Reveals the image through a directional scale-based wipe with adjustable stretch, center, and direction.
az-scatterize: Scatters source samples using a randomized displacement field with independent left/right twists, scatter amount, and transfer mode.
az-slant: Slants the layer along a selected axis with stretch and floor controls, optionally filling the exposed region with a chosen color.
az-snowfall: Overlays animated snowflakes with depth-based size and speed variation, wind, spread, wiggle, flatness, color, and opacity controls.
az-sphere: Maps the layer onto a rotating 3D sphere with XYZ rotation, radius, offset, rotation order, and inside/outside render modes.
az-split: Splits the layer along a line between two points, with adjustable split distance and source-preserving behavior around the seam.
az-split-2: Creates a two-stage directional split using two points and two split distances, with preset profiles for the separation behavior.
az-threads: Renders the image as overlapping directional threads with width, height, overlap, coverage, center, direction, shadowing, and texture controls.
az-threshold: Converts the source to a thresholded mask using luminance, saturation, or a selected channel, with inversion and original-image blending.
az-threshold-rgb: Thresholds red, green, and blue independently with per-channel levels, inversion switches, and blend-back control.
az-tiler: Repeats and scales the source around a chosen center, with adjustable tile scale and blend amount against the original.
az-toner: Maps luminance into duotone, tritone, pentone, or solid color ramps with selectable tone colors and original-image blending.
az-vector-blur: Blurs along a vector field derived from a selected source channel, offering direction modes, amount, revolutions, ridge smoothing, and map softness.
bcc-ripple-dissolve: Dissolves the layer with a propagating ripple ring, controlling progress, radius, wave width/height, speed, falloff, pinning, and rim lighting.
better-ramp: Builds a linear or radial two-color ramp with opacity endpoints, color swapping, perceptual mixing, bias, scatter, radial highlights, and blend mode.
better-ramp-v2: Creates a multi-stop linear or radial gradient with up to eight colors, reverse/offset controls, warp and scatter, highlights, and blend opacity.
bevel-alpha: Adds a beveled edge from the source alpha with thickness, light angle, light color, softness, opacity, and optional inner/outer shading.
block-dissolve: Reveals or removes the source in randomized rectangular blocks with adjustable completion, block size, softness, and edge behavior.
brush-strokes: Repaints the source as randomized brush-like strokes with adjustable size, length, angle, density, color variation, and scattering.
cartoon: Produces a cartoon treatment by flattening color regions and extracting softened edges, with selectable fill/edge output, threshold, radius, and edge controls.
change-color: Selects pixels by hue, RGB distance, and chroma distance, then shifts their hue, saturation, and lightness with feathered tolerance controls.
change-to-color: Replaces or transforms a selected color range using hue, saturation, and lightness masks while preserving luminance and controlling feather softness.
channel-mixer: Remixes output channels from independent red, green, blue, and constant channel contributions with per-channel monochrome and alpha controls.
checkerboard: Generates a checkerboard pattern from configurable size, anchor, rotation, colors, opacity, and blend mode settings.
chromabba: Separates and curves RGB channels around a configurable center, with radius, edge mode, directional vectors, and channel-specific aberration controls.
circle: Draws a positioned circle, ring, or soft edge mask with pixel radius, feathering, fill/stroke colors, blend mode, and source compositing controls.
clay: Gives the image a molded clay appearance through color flattening, procedural wrinkles, displaced sampling, and directional matte emboss shading.
color-balance: Adjusts shadows, midtones, and highlights using tone-weighted luminance-preserving color balance controls for red, green, and blue channels.
color-balance-hsl: Performs HSL color balancing with separate hue rotation, lightness offset, and saturation offset controls.
colorama: Maps luminance or color through a configurable cyclic color palette with phase, cycle count, modify/mask modes, and selectable combination behavior.
colorvsn: Applies selectable scientific and artistic color maps, including viridis, plasma, turbo, HSV, and grayscale variants, with source-channel selection and blend controls.
corner-pin: Warps the source into an arbitrary quadrilateral using inverse bilinear corner pinning with independently positioned corners.
cr-lumaramp: Remaps luminance through a color ramp interpolated in selectable HSV, Lab, or HCL-style color spaces with preset or custom colors.
crtx-lite: Simulates a lightweight CRT display with curvature, chromatic temperature, RGB bleed/glitch, scanline-style masking, noise, and vignette controls.
curl-noise: Distorts the layer with a procedural curl-noise flow field, exposing noise scale, evolution, turbulence, curl strength, and flow direction controls.
curves: Applies an adjustable cubic curve to RGB, individual channels, or alpha using four AE-style control points and a selectable channel.
cyanotype: Creates a cyanotype print treatment with selectable chemistry presets, blue toning, paper fibers, water stains, grain, and blend intensity.
deep-glow: Builds a deep multi-directional glow from bright and chromatic source regions with linear-light processing, tint, width, threshold, and blend controls.
dot-pixel: Converts the image into pixel-sized spherical or ring-shaped dots with adjustable size, spacing, angle, color source, and optional edge behavior.
drop-shadow: Generates a filtered alpha drop shadow with color, angle, distance, blur, opacity, spread, and transparent-edge handling.
echo: Layers time-offset samples of the source into a controllable echo trail with echo count, starting opacity, time offset, decay, and blend mode.
echo-2: Creates a second echo variant that composites repeated time-offset frames with configurable count, offset, opacity decay, and color blending.
element-glow: Extracts a selectable source range and builds a colored gradient glow with threshold, mask strength, width, channel widths, and alpha compositing controls.
ellipse: Draws a positioned ellipse or elliptical ring with independent radii, rotation, feather, stroke width, fill color, and blend/composite settings.
engraving: Simulates an engraved print by quantizing luminance into directional hatch marks and adding randomized wear-and-tear grain.
exposure: Applies AE-style exposure, offset, and gamma correction either globally or independently to red, green, and blue channels.
fast-box-blur: Performs a premultiplied-alpha box blur horizontally, vertically, or both with adjustable pixel radius, quality, and edge repetition.
fill: Overlays a chosen color onto the source with adjustable opacity and a selectable source/alpha compositing mode.
find-edges: Extracts normalized Sobel edges in linear color space and converts the result back to display space with adjustable original-image blending.
fractal-noise: Generates configurable fractal, turbulence, ridged, or domain-warped noise with scale, complexity, evolution, overflow, color, and blend controls.
gamma-pedestal-gain: Adjusts black pedestal, gamma, and gain independently per channel, including shadow stretch for controlled tonal shaping.
gaussian-blur: Applies a separable Gaussian blur horizontally, vertically, or in both directions with pixel radius, quality, and edge controls.
glasswork: Creates patterned frosted glass using procedural strips, zigzags, rhombuses, or waves with noise, blur, displacement, and pattern controls.
glow: Builds a customizable source-derived glow from two colors using selectable sawtooth or triangle color cycles, threshold, width, and blend operation.
gradient-ramp: Applies a linear or radial two-color gradient between positioned endpoints with interpolation, opacity, ramp offset, and original blending.
grid: Draws a configurable grid over the image with anchor, width/height sizing, line thickness, rotation, color, opacity, and blend mode controls.
heisei-vhs: Emulates a worn VHS signal with YIQ color processing, scanline and tracking artifacts, chromatic noise, jitter, head switching, and tape distortion.
hotwave: Distorts the layer with animated multi-octave hot-air wave noise, controlling wave direction, amplitude, scale, blur, evolution, and edge behavior.
hsl-noise: Adds procedural noise independently to hue, saturation, and lightness, with uniform, squared, or grain noise modes and animated seed control.
hsl-noise-auto: Automatically animates HSL noise over time, offering uniform, squared, or grain distributions and independent hue, saturation, and lightness intensity.
hydrochrome: Applies an animated hydrochromic color distortion with directional rotation, manual or automatic evolution, strength, and alpha-preserving compositing.
impact-lines: Generates animated radial or speed lines from a pixel-positioned center with line count, length, width, taper, randomness, color, and opacity controls.
invert: Inverts or remaps selected color channels, luminance, hue, saturation, lightness, or alpha with channel selection, amount, and blend controls.
iris-wipe: Reveals the layer through a polygonal iris opening with adjustable center, spike count, size, feather, rotation, and reverse direction.
iris-wipe-2: Creates a sharper star-shaped iris transition with controllable polygon points, outer radius, spike distortion, rotation, and feathering.
leave-color: Preserves a selected color range while progressively decolorizing other pixels using luminance, hue/RGB tolerance, and edge softness.
lens-flare: Renders a procedural lens flare at a pixel position with selectable camera profile, intensity, glow radius, color, streaks, and opacity.
levels: Applies input/output black and white points plus gamma to RGB, individual channels, or alpha with selectable channel targeting.
levels-individual-controls: Provides separate input/output levels and gamma controls for RGB, red, green, blue, and alpha, with optional local smoothing.
linear-wipe: Reveals or hides the source along a rotated linear boundary with completion, feather width, direction, and edge softness controls.
liquid-glass: Creates a liquid-glass refraction from the source alpha using quality-controlled mask blur, chromatic offsets, distortion, and lighting.
lumetri-color: Provides a broad Lumetri-style grade with white balance, exposure, contrast, tonal controls, saturation, vibrance, curves, split tone, secondary HSL keying, and vignette.
mangatone: Creates a manga-toned image by posterizing luminance, adding rotated screen patterns, and extracting Sobel-style ink outlines.
median: Reduces speckle noise with exact or approximate median filtering over selectable neighborhoods and channels, preserving edges better than a blur.
minimax: Applies morphological maximum, minimum, opening, or closing filters along horizontal and vertical paths with channel selection, radius, angle, and softness.
minimax-2: Applies a directional one-pass morphological maximum, minimum, opening, or closing filter with adjustable radius, channel, angle, and blend behavior.
mosaic: Pixelates the image by averaging or sampling texel-centered blocks with adjustable block size and quality-aware source buffer mapping.
motion-tile: Repeats the layer beyond its bounds with mirror tiling, offset, anchor, motion angle, and separate horizontal/vertical expansion controls.
mt-s-pixelsorter: Sorts pixels along a chosen direction by brightness, saturation, hue, or RGB using threshold ranges, length, displacement, and true-sort controls.
multislicer: Slices the layer into many horizontal or vertical strips and offsets them with seeded random positions, speed, width, anchor, and edge controls.
nesprite: Converts the source into an NES-style sprite using a limited palette, pixelation, selectable Bayer dithering matrix, and sprite scaling controls.
night-vision: Simulates night vision with green luminance conversion, animated sensor noise, bloom, vignette, scanline structure, and adjustable gain.
nimble-nimbus: Generates a layered procedural cloud or nimbus texture with noise-based cloud design, top/bottom shaping, lighting, color, and animation controls.
nisai-stroke: Applies a stylized multi-directional stroke treatment using configurable direction, length, spacing, offset, color, opacity, and alpha behavior.
noise: Adds animated mono or RGB procedural noise with adjustable amount, scale, monochrome mode, blend mode, and opacity.
optics-compensation: Corrects or exaggerates lens distortion by applying a field-of-view-based radial warp with zoom, center, and horizontal/vertical/diagonal orientation.
oscilloscope: Renders the image as a glowing CRT oscilloscope display with beam thickness, phosphor color, flicker, persistence, curvature, and scanline controls.
photocopy-scan-lines: Creates a photocopy look by converting to monochrome, adding noisy streaks and scan lines, and controlling contrast, threshold, blur, and paper tone.
pro-line-extract: Extracts stylized lines using XDoG anime, XDoG manga, or multiply-blur modes with radius, threshold, softness, and edge color controls.
progradient: Builds a multi-stop gradient with linear, radial, or contour mapping, perceptual OKLCH color interpolation, dithering, tiling, and alpha-aware blending.
qc-color-analyzer: Displays sampled color analysis overlays including RGB, HSV, and LCH readouts, a sampling circle, swatch, background opacity, and scale/offset controls.
radial-blur: Applies a center-based spin or zoom blur with adjustable amount, quality, center, antialiasing, and randomized sample distribution.
radial-wipe: Reveals the layer around a radial angle from a chosen center with transition completion, wipe direction, feather, and start angle.
reramp: Re-ramp colors through up to eight stops with perceptual Kubelka–Munk/OKLab-style mixing, tiling, bias, quantization, dithering, and source mapping.
ripple: Creates an animated radial ripple distortion with symmetric or asymmetric wave profiles, radius, speed, width, height, phase, and center controls.
risograph: Simulates a risograph print with separate dark/light inks, paper color, halftone screening, misregistration, roughness, and tone lift.
s-edgecolorize: Colorizes image edges from four directional colors after linear-light blurred edge detection with subpixel smoothing and brightness control.
s-glint: Adds animated directional glints to bright source regions with hue shifting, RGB and diagonal ray sizes, threshold blur, alpha sourcing, and background brightness.
s-glow: Builds a thresholded, channel-separated glow with selectable combine/blend modes, atmosphere noise, width controls, and source/alpha compositing options.
s-halftone: Renders a rotated halftone screen with adjustable dot frequency, width, sharpness, shift, lighten mode, source smoothing, and two ink colors.
s-kaleido: Creates configurable kaleidoscopic tiling with selectable geometric fold patterns, center/depth transforms, inner transforms, wrapping, and kaleido amount.
s-kaleidopolar: Maps the image into repeated polar kaleidoscope sectors with center, depth, rotation, stretch, inner shift, repeat count, and kaleido amount.
s-kaleidoradial: Generates animated radial kaleidoscope slices with configurable slice count, center/depth, rotations, inner motion, shifting, wrapping, and fold amount.
s-shake: Animates layered translation, rotation, depth, motion blur, cropping, and independent RGB jitter using selectable procedural shake styles.
s-shape: Draws a configurable polygon or rounded star shape with points, pointiness, roundness, swirl, rotation, blur, gradient colors, and compositing.
s-wipeblobs: Performs a noisy organic blob wipe using animated fractal noise, frequency, edge softness, gradient direction, and optional colored border.
s-wipecells: Wipes through animated Voronoi cells with cell count, noise frequency, edge softness, gradient direction, and optional border styling.
s-wipedoublewedge: Reveals the layer with a symmetrical double-wedge wipe whose angle, pointiness, edge softness, direction, and border are adjustable.
s-wipefourwedges: Reveals the layer through four directional wedges with angle, aspect scaling, edge softness, direction, and border controls.
s-wipemoire: Creates a moiré-ring wipe from two independently positioned and rotated radial patterns with phase animation, frequency, edge softness, and border styling.
s-wipepixelate: Wipes the source through progressively ordered pixel cells with angle, frequency, cell width, chunky variation, edge width, and time/manual control.
s-wipeplasma: Uses animated multi-octave plasma noise as a wipe field with frequency, layers, gradient direction, phase speed, edge softness, and border controls.
s-wipetiles: Wipes through morphing triangular, hexagonal, diamond, or tiled shapes with snapping, rotation, frequency, edge softness, gradients, and borders.
s-wipeweave: Creates a woven-strand wipe from animated fractal noise with strand count, frequency, length, motion speeds, edge softness, gradient, and border controls.
scl-film-strip: Draws repeated film-strip geometry with independently configurable base, main, and sub-strip copies, scales, offsets, roundedness, positions, colors, and strokes.
sepia: Applies a sepia print treatment by mixing luminance with ink tone and controlling tint density and print definition.
simple-choker: Chokes or expands the source alpha matte with a controllable pixel radius and optional matte-only preview.
star-trail-motion: Generates animated star trails with randomized length, width, range, rotation, dash, color gradient, speed, and opacity variation.
stretch: Stretches or compresses the layer from an anchor point along a chosen direction with angle and shift controls.
texgraph: Renders the source as a compact procedural 3x5 character graph with scaling, erosion, dithering, source-derived text/background colors, and alpha control.
the-matrix: Generates animated green Matrix-style character rain with adjustable stream frequency, speed, brightness, and alpha mode.
the-matrix-2: Renders a more detailed Matrix rain field with procedural rune glyphs, animated streams, density, speed, color, and alpha-mode controls.
threshold: Converts the source to a Rec.709 luminance threshold mask with an adjustable level.
tint: Maps source luminance between configurable black and white colors with adjustable tint amount and color swapping.
transform: Applies AE-style 2D transform sampling with position, anchor, independent scale, skew, rotation, opacity, shutter-angle motion blur, and sampling quality.
tritone: Maps Rec.709 luminance into independently colored shadow, midtone, and highlight regions with original-image blending.
turbulent-displace: Displaces the source with animated simplex fractal noise, controlling displacement axis, amount, size, complexity, evolution, pinning, and layer resizing.
turbulent-noise: Generates 3D fractal turbulence with selectable noise/fractal type, domain warping, scaling, evolution, overflow, color, opacity, and blend mode.
twirl: Applies a localized rotational twirl around a pixel-positioned center with adjustable angle and radius.
unmult: Removes black or white matte contamination by reconstructing color and alpha from luminance, with black level, softness, color-removal, and HDR clipping controls.
unsharp-mask: Sharpens the source with a Gaussian high-pass mask gated by luma threshold, exposing amount, radius, and threshold controls.
venetian-blinds: Reveals the layer through angled Venetian-blind slats with completion, direction, slat width, and feather controls.
warp: Applies selectable radial, bend, and axis-based warp models with horizontal/vertical distortion, bend amount, and warp-axis controls.
wave-warp: Distorts the layer with animated directional waves using selectable wave shape, height, width, speed, phase, pinning, and antialiasing controls.
